settings.title: Editor engine
settings.description: browser: ONLYOFFICE runs in your browser from a one-time download of about 200 MB, with no Docker; two tabs on one file don't co-edit, and a save that would overwrite someone else's change asks first. server: ONLYOFFICE Docs runs as a container in this sandbox's Docker engine (a 2 GB image and a two-minute cold start), and two tabs co-edit live. Documents on your own computer, opened in the desktop app, always use the browser engine.

settings.title: Prepare the editor with the sandbox
settings.description: Gets the chosen engine ready when the sandbox starts, in the background, so the first document opens without the wait: the browser engine's one-time download, or the document server's container (a 2 GB pull on the first boot, then a two-minute cold start). Off: the first document you open does it, which is also how documents on your own computer get it, since those have no sandbox to start with.
